page: Microsoft Azure NV4ads_V710_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the NVadsV710v5 server family. Powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and includes 275 GB of local storage, with support for Premium Storage configurations.

A key characteristic of this instance is its fractional GPU allocation. It is equipped with approximately 0.1667 of an AMD Radeon Pro V710 GPU, providing 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. This fractional GPU architecture allows users to access hardware-accelerated graphics capabilities without the cost of a full, dedicated physical GPU, making it a resource-efficient option for workloads that require moderate GPU acceleration but do not saturate a full graphics card.

Given its hardware profile, the NV4ads_V710_v5 is designed for entry-level virtual desktop infrastructure, lightweight 3D rendering, CAD applications, and basic GPU-accelerated development tasks. The combination of 4 dedicated vCPUs, 16.0 GB of RAM, and a 4 GB VRAM fractional GPU provides a balanced environment for interactive graphical workloads and general-purpose computing tasks that benefit from hardware acceleration.
